components.evidence: PE32/PE32+ mapping, relocations and normal imports are tested. Exports, name/ordinal lookup, forwarded exports with bounded depth and cycle detection, runtime-to-runtime import binding, and the PE32 TLS directory plus a process/thread TLS owner with callback plans are implemented and host-tested; delay imports remain.
Wine modules have an explicit runtime origin; POSIX and PS5 providers keep independently configured application/runtime roots, covered by host tests.

The first PE32 title is playable on FW 12.02 with exact host parity and bounded hardware evidence. The Wine host gate adds FS-relative operands, atomic LOCK/CMPXCHG and memory XCHG, byte accumulators, BT/BTS/BTR/BTC, CMOVcc, the tested SSE lane slice, BSF/BSR and 16-bit shifts. A generated PE32 application reaches its own entry point and exits cleanly after exactly 598404 retired instructions and 2981 blocks in all four chaining/register-residency configurations. Resident byte aliases consume current host-register state, common 32-bit ALU operations execute directly on resident registers, and profitability filters avoid residency in tiny and helper-heavy blocks.
Synthetic integer call bridge exists; imports, callbacks, FP/vector arguments and exception transitions remain.

Wine revision 490f6d5d produces a manifest-validated i386 distribution containing ntdll, kernelbase, kernel32 and all 76 tracked NLS files. A bounded host gate publishes both dispatchers, maps runtime and application namespaces, builds the initial PEB/TEB/process parameters and CONTEXT, and services 32 NT call shapes. A generated PE32 executable plus two DLLs loads through Wine's own ntdll, reaches its transfer address, returns 1 and exits through NtTerminateThread after exactly 598404 retired instructions and 2981 blocks in all four chaining/register-residency configurations. Loader-list identity and DllMain/TLS ordering are not yet independently validated, the prefix is not persistent and no PS5 Wine launch is claimed.

Both dispatcher slots are found in the built image and published through the TEB. The 256-entry i386 syscall table and eight-entry ntdll Unix-call table match the pinned Wine source, including frame layout and the debug-write parameter ABI. The handler ledger contains 32 serviced NT call shapes plus classified process/thread termination stops. Implemented families include virtual memory, files and identity, image sections and protections, registry open/create/query/set, object namespace, process/thread queries, NtContinue, NLS mappings and locale queries. Guest spans are preflighted and ownership is gate-local; refusals return explicit NTSTATUS instead of fabricated success.

One Wine guest thread has isolated CPU/FP/FS state, a populated TEB/PEB/process-parameter page, image-sized stack, activation-context stack, client identity and initial I386_CONTEXT. NtGetNextThread, NtQueryInformationThread and NtContinue are host-tested; the generated application's first thread reaches its entry point and exits through NtTerminateThread. Wine owns PEB_LDR_DATA, but its lists and DllMain/TLS callback ordering still need read-back validation. Native multi-thread scheduling and general wait objects remain.

The Wine gate has a typed monotonic handle table plus bounded file, registry, directory-object and section-object profiles. General Wine-compatible events, mutexes, semaphores and waits are not yet implemented.
Low-address reserve/commit/protect/release and W^X DBT publication are validated for the current profile.
Precise DBT faults exist, but PE32 SEH dispatch/unwind and Wine context delivery do not.

Title-confined read/seek and INI access exist. The Wine host gate separates runtime and application namespaces, canonicalizes DOS/NT names, rejects traversal and alternate streams, and services bounded open/read/query/close plus stable file identity. SEC_IMAGE sections can be described, mapped from file bytes and protected with one page-granular permission map shared by the host backend and guest guard. The portable core reaches storage only through injected services. Persistent drive_c storage, full DOS-device mapping, sharing, directory enumeration and overlapped I/O remain.

The direct bootstrap has a bounded persistent registry and CP1252 support. The Wine distribution stages and hashes all 76 NLS files from the pinned revision; the gate maps locale/codepage data below 4 GiB, publishes a UTF-16 process environment and supports UTF-8 canonical registry names including surrogate pairs. Its create/query/set registry store is currently run-local. Crash-safe prefix persistence, registry views and two-run/two-prefix isolation remain.
WinMM PCM and DualSense-to-message adapters are hardware validated for one title.
No Winsock compatibility surface is claimed.
DXVK is the selected D3D8/9/10/11 path; it has not started on PS5.
The companion project renders and computes on gfx1013 but does not yet satisfy its pinned DXVK consumer profile.
ps5log/1 identity, runtime counters and ordered close/relaunch are hardware validated.
